findings.description: Argument.get_help_record returns (metavar, self.help) unchanged, so an argument with help=None yields a None description instead of the empty string the new docstring promises.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with one documented argument and one undocumented argument. format_help_text only calls write_dl when any argument has help, then passes the undocumented argument's record (metavar, None) to write_dl. The formatter then processes None as text, which either raises a TypeError or renders incorrectly. Impact: the help page for such a command crashes or is malformed, where the title says it should show an empty description.
